name: Palel–Chandel National Highway
significance: NH 102C is a branch of NH 102. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Palel to Chandel, and it meets NH 102 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 102 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Namphalong Bazar to Babupara
